# Daily campaign spend counter in Redis

> A Redis counter per campaign and day that tracks spend against daily budgets, incremented on valid clicks and expiring after two days.

_Part of [Sponsored ad campaigns and serving](sponsored-ad-campaigns.md)_

When someone clicks a sponsored ad, the system increments a Redis counter for that campaign's daily spend—but only if the click passes all fraud checks. The counter holds cumulative cost in cents, keyed by campaign ID and calendar day. This counter is checked every time the system picks sponsored ads to show: it filters out campaigns that have spent their daily budget. It's an approximate, real-time check that keeps budgets from being badly overshot, though it doesn't drive the actual billing—[exact billing](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) happens later, reconciled daily from the raw click log. The counter expires after 2 days, and each calendar day gets its own separate counter. A campaign's spend is incremented in the [click handler](ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md) only after token verification, impression deduplication, and per-IP burst filtering all pass.

**Look at:** [`spendKey` in ads.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/ads.service.ts#L16) · [`click` in ads.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/ads.service.ts#L9) · [`sponsored` in ads.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/ads.service.ts#L49)

## Pieces

- Redis key format for campaign daily spend: One counter per campaign per calendar day, keyed as `adspend:{campaignId}:YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Incrementing spend when a valid click is recorded: After all fraud checks pass, the counter is incremented by the campaign's cost-per-click (`cpcCents`) and the key is set to expire in 2 days (172,800 seconds).
- Using spend to filter campaigns during ad selection: Before returning ads to show, the `sponsored` method fetches each campaign's current spend and filters out any where today's spend plus the CPC would exceed the daily budget, returning the top 3 by price.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| cache | `Redis keys: `adspend:{`campaignId`}:YYYY-MM-DD`` | Incremented by cost-per-click (`cpcCents`) on each valid click; read during ad selection to check remaining budget; expires after 2 days to clean up old data |

## Watch out

- The spend counter is approximate—it reflects valid clicks real-time, but the actual billing is {{ad-click-aggregation-and-billing|reconciled daily}} from the raw click log and may differ if fraud is detected later or a click is disputed.
- Budget is a soft limit: the check happens during ad selection but clicks are recorded asynchronously, so concurrent clicks on multiple ads can collectively exceed the daily budget.
- The calendar day and budget reset are in UTC (the key uses `YYYY-MM-DD` from ISO date), not local seller time, so a seller's perceived business day may not align with the budget window.
